origine_fr: En bas, 辶, la marche ; dessus, 反 (厂 et 又), se retourner, qui donne aussi le son (fǎn). Marcher en se retournant. C'est revenir.
origine_en: Below, 辶, walking; on it, 反 (厂 and 又), to turn back, which also gives the sound (fǎn). Walking back the way you came. It means to return.

mots.en: round trip, to go back and forth
